actual_scope: Audit and repair stderr normalization collisions in the integrated PR921 isolated-test benchmark, preserving every captured byte except the final standard unittest elapsed value.
scope_change_reason: Refine the canonical-payload comparison card to one concrete benchmark receipt: the current unanchored timing regex and replacement decoding can erase non-timing diagnostic bytes.
bottleneck_link: Exact portable receipt comparison prevents a verifier scheduling experiment from silently accepting changed diagnostics. This is review tooling, with no supplier profile, moment or kappa change.
stop_rule: One approximately 60-minute session: two exact collision classes, a byte-preserving comparator, bounded real captures and fault controls, source pins and submission. No full-suite performance claim.
evidence: Two complete byte collisions, real unittest captures, and source-bound end-to-end benchmark controls; deterministic RESULT.json; 20 tests pass under normal and optimized Python.
author: Arham Tahir
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in audit, code, tests and writing. No subagents or independent human review.
